name: Milvus Vector Database
description: General-purpose vector-database tools: semantic upsert/search/delete against a Milvus server, embedding text via any OpenAI-compatible embeddings API.

connection.address.label: Milvus Address
connection.address.help: Milvus server address as host:port (or https://host:port for Zilliz Cloud)

connection.token.label: API Token
connection.token.help: API token (Zilliz Cloud) or user:password token; supports ${ENV_VAR}

embedding.apiKey.label: Embedding API Key
embedding.apiKey.help: API key for the OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint (or use ${OPENAI_API_KEY})

embedding.baseUrl.label: Base URL
embedding.baseUrl.help: Base URL for compatible providers (e.g. DashScope, Ollama)

embedding.dimensions.label: Dimensions
embedding.dimensions.help: Vector dimensions for custom/non-standard models (required unless using a known OpenAI model)

embedding.sendDimensions.label: Send Dimensions Param
embedding.sendDimensions.help: Whether to send a dimensions param to the embeddings endpoint. Disable for providers that reject it (e.g. Volcengine Ark).

embeddingProfiles.label: Additional Embedding Profiles
embeddingProfiles.help: Named embedding configs (same shape as embedding) selectable per tool call via embeddingProfile, for collections that use a different provider/model/dimension.

readOnlyCollections.label: Read-Only Collections
readOnlyCollections.help: Collection names that milvus_upsert/milvus_delete must refuse to write to.
